## Summary

- Clarify substantive slice, aggregate and PR review duties, preserving independent reviews and strict standalone Deepreview.
- Reuse applicable actual validation across gates; revalidate affected work and retain mandatory checks.
- Make fix/re-review conditional on real fixes in all review loops; unresolved blockers, needs-more-evidence and inadequate evidence still block.
- Allow traceable references to unchanged artifact facts while keeping current decisions/evidence and substantive final closeout.

Product changes are limited to Gateflow, Deepreview and Phaseflow SKILL text. Planreview was checked and needs no change. No runner, model/provider, business-project or permission changes.

## Validation and review

One approved slice. GPT Sol performed plan/implementation. MiMo Flash and DS Flash independently reviewed in parallel at plan, slice and aggregate gates; all passed, controller adjudicated. Actual PR review follows on the created PR and precise head/base OIDs under the same two routes.

Existing skill metadata validators and relevant whitespace checks pass; representative textual scenarios check no-findings pass, real fixes, interacting slices, stale evidence, unresolved blockers, PR version movement and missing references. Evidence: docs/gateflow/gateflow-review-efficiency/.

Original diff evidence was losslessly compressed after literal unified-diff context spaces triggered a staged whitespace check; original failure and decoded hash/byte equality are preserved. No source change was needed.

## Delivery boundaries

Draft for manual merge. Reviewed skill sync is authorized after review/report, with deployed-text matching only. User revoked runtime live probes; none are a completion condition. No measured speed/token improvement or runtime enforcement is claimed. No linked GitHub issue for this workflow optimization.
